name: memory-match
description: Premium Memory Card Game with React, Vite, Node.js, Express, and SQLite

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
